events.name: Victor Goines Quartet
events.info: Victor Goines QuartetVictor Goines, a New Orleans native, is an acclaimed jazz saxophonist, clarinetist, composer, and educator who began on clarinet at age eight before adding saxophone in high school, inspired by local legends like Ellis Marsalis. A graduate of Loyola University New Orleans and Virginia Commonwealth University, he has been a key member of the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra and Wynton Marsalis Septet since 1993, contributing to major recordings including the Pulitzer Prize--winning Blood on the Fields and collaborating with icons such as Ray Charles, Dizzy Gillespie, Stevie Wonder, and Bob Dylan. A prolific composer with over 200 works and a bandleader with ten albums, Goines has also played a major role in jazz education, leading programs at Juilliard and Northwestern University before becoming President & CEO of Jazz St. Louis from 2022 -2026. This performance features: Victor Goines - saxophone, bandleader Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7pm & 9pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner before or after your showtime: Advance Ticket Holders can now automatically make dinner table reservations for the Dining Room online via OpenTable.com ! We do offer cheese and charcuterie tray options. events.info: NOLATETAcclaimed New Orleans ensemble Nolatet returns to Snug Harbor for an evening of adventurous jazz, deep grooves, and fearless improvisation. The quartet brings together legendary New Orleans bassist James Singleton and drummer Johnny Vidacovich with acclaimed vibraphonist and percussionist Mike Dillon and pianist Brian Haas---four distinctive voices creating a sound that is as unpredictable as it is deeply rooted in the Crescent City tradition. The group recently released Somethin' To Relax With, their first new album since 2018, featuring music recorded live during two sold-out performances in Tulsa. Experience Nolatet live at Snug Harbor for an evening of inventive music, spontaneous interplay, and New Orleans groove. events.name: Alejandro Canales Trio with Dylan Torrance and Simon Lott
events.info: Alejandro Canales Trio with Dylan Torrance and Simon Lott*Happy Hour Concert Series* featuring Alejandro Canales Trio with Dylan Torrance and Simon Lott Texas-born saxophonist Alejandro Canales has built an international career performing across jazz, Motown, R&B, classical, and rock. A versatile multi-instrumentalist, Canales also plays flute and clarinet and has toured extensively with Royal Caribbean and Celebrity Cruises. His performance credits include the Reno Jazz Orchestra, Soul Brass Band, Treme Brass Band, and Trombone Shorty, and he released his debut album, Bluish Hue. New Orleans-based guitarist, educator, and content creator Dylan Torrance brings a diverse musical background spanning jazz, funk, Cuban music, bossa nova, and blues. He holds bachelor's and master's degrees from the University of New Orleans, where he studied with Steve Masakowski, Brian Seeger, and Hank Mackie. Torrance has performed with some of New Orleans' finest musicians, toured nationally, and continues to teach and perform throughout the city. Rounding out the trio is drummer Simon Lott, whose creative approach and dynamic musicianship make him a sought-after collaborator on the New Orleans jazz scene. Together, Canales, Torrance, and Lott deliver an evening of adventurous jazz, groove, and improvisation. Doors: 4 pm Show: 4:30 - 6 pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner after showtime Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro presents live weekly concerts. You can see these shows every Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday in person or by streaming on the Snug Harbor Facebook page. This is a free performance with no ticketing. Seating is on a first come-first served basis. Tips for the band are encouraged and go 100% to the musicians.

events.name: ELEW "The Top Professor" & Herlin Riley featuring Max Moran
events.info: ELEW "The Top Professor" & Herlin Riley featuring Max MoranExperience an electrifying night of jazz, rock, and improvisation featuring visionary pianist ELEW , "rdquo" -> The Top Professor"alongside legendary New Orleans drummer Herlin Riley, with bassist Max Moran. A classically trained jazz pianist, ELEW (Eric Lewis) first gained national recognition as the winner of the prestigious Thelonious Monk Competition and went on to perform alongside artists including Wynton Marsalis and Elvin Jones. He later re-emerged as ELEW, pioneering his signature , "rdquo" -> Rockjazz" sound---a dynamic fusion of jazz improvisation, classical technique, and modern rock and pop. ELEW's boundary-pushing performances have taken him around the world, from major brands and international events to the White House, where he performed for President Barack Obama. His creative work also extends into film composition, screenwriting, directing, and DJing. Joining ELEW is New Orleans jazz legend Herlin Riley, whose powerful drumming, deep musicality, and unmistakable Crescent City swing have made him one of the most respected figures in contemporary jazz. Bassist Max Moran rounds out this exceptional trio, bringing his distinctive sound and versatility to a musical encounter that promises spontaneity, groove, and virtuosic musicianship. Don't miss this rare meeting of three dynamic artists exploring the boundaries of jazz and contemporary music.
